summary: glirastes upgrade report lists release notes since the version this app last reviewed, checked against your code, and is the way agents learn what to do after an upgrade.
howTo: After each glirastes upgrade, or when `glirastes tools refresh` prints its upgrade line, run `glirastes upgrade report` and follow the upgrading-glirastes skill. When the review is done, `glirastes upgrade ack` (with `--defer <id>` for postponed items) records it in `.glirastes/sdk-baseline.json`; commit that file.
